spans.s:
m. (-ष्ठः)
The month Jyaiṣṭha or Jyeṣṭha or Jeyte, (May-June.)
f. (-ष्ठी)
1 The day of full moon in Jyeṣṭha.
2 A house lizard.
E.
ज्यैष्ठा the mansion or asterism which the moon is in this month, and अण् aff.

m. (-मा)
A Brahman versed in that portion of the Sāma Veda called Jyeṣṭha Sāma.
E.
ज्येष्ठसामन् as above, aff. अण्.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Born of the elder or principal wife.
E.
ज्यैष्ठा, and ढक् affix, इनङ् inserted.

n. (-ष्ठ्यं)
Seniority, age.
E.
ज्यैष्ट, and यञ् aff.
